stem: Mitchell wants to help readers move from the fourth paragraph (sentences 16–23) to the fifth paragraph (sentences 24–26). Which sentence or sentences should Mitchell insert at the beginning of the fifth paragraph, just before sentence 24?

options.label: B
options.text: Uh-oh! Another animal is just around the corner.

options.label: C
options.text: Then Lauren hears a stomp and a huff.

options.label: D
options.text: The tiger is trapped and won’t be going anywhere.
